title: The Kid Who Rage-Wrote His Dad
aria: Animated stick-figure short about a boy's angry letter to his father from Roman Egypt, papyrus P.Oxy. I 119
foot: Space plays or pauses. Arrow keys step 1 s (Shift: 0.1 s). Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects are synthesized for this video. Quotes: Grenfell and Hunt's 1898 translation of P.Oxy. I 119 (Bodleian Library, Oxford). Characters, reactions and settings are illustrations; the papyrus is redrawn, not photographed.
